skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key terms related to Marketing, Online Marketing, Digital Marketing; Website Marketing, Virtual Stores...; have a general overview of the Online Marketing system.
Explain different types of online marketing and apply them practically.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Deploy and Operate Online Marketing Systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Deploy, operate, and develop a website marketing, virtual store, online marketing system for businesses.
Proficiently use SEO tools and website analysis tools to optimize search engines, improve website rankings, and enhance digital content rankings on internet search engines.

Analyze real-world marketing problems in various fields such as healthcare, education, business, banking, finance, accounting, insurance, statistics, tourism... to decide on using IT tools to assist in online marketing activities at businesses.
Develop skills in analyzing, designing, and building SEO-compliant websites and virtual stores.
Manage and exploit websites to serve marketing strategies of businesses.
Have the ability to self-study, read materials, think about online marketing, approach and solve digital marketing issues in businesses.
Be able to work independently or actively, positively, and effectively participate in group activities. Have the ability to organize group activities.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Systems Management.
